contracts.protection_obligation: State-changing gateway HTTP requests (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) other than the exempt auth endpoints must carry a csrf_token cookie and an X-CSRF-Token header whose values match exactly; CSRFMiddleware, registered on the FastAPI app in create_app, must reject non-conforming state-changing requests with HTTP 403 before the route handler executes.
scope_limits: Auth endpoints (/api/v1/auth/login/local, /logout, /register, /initialize) and /api/v1/auth/me are exempt from the double-submit check; auth POSTs are instead gated by same-origin/configured-origin rejection (is_allowed_auth_origin, csrf_middleware.py:148-182).
GET, HEAD, OPTIONS, and TRACE are exempt per RFC 7231 (should_check_csrf).

The middleware is a generic HTTP-layer control; supplied source does not bind the guarded operations to agent tool dispatch or agent lifecycle, so agent mediation is not established and must not be inferred from the repository's agent-backend topic.
